name: happy-code
description: Guided solo pipeline for one development task end-to-end — grill, spec, tracer-bullet tickets, impact analysis, confirm gate, laziest working implementation, self-review — plus skills to create a ClickUp ticket, to pick up an existing ticket from ClickUp, GitHub or elsewhere, and to play a manual UI test plan on a visible browser with an on-screen check panel, a Ticket Cockpit pane beside the chat that shows the task in progress, and a Screen-Test Board pane with every test case's latest verdict. Replies in Thai through a switchable reply-style section (ADHD-friendly shape, show-me views, 1A/1B question blocks).

thaiStyle.title: Thai style rules
thaiStyle.description: Add happy-code's reply rules (Thai, ADHD-friendly shape, show-me views, 1A/1B question blocks) to every session
